narratives.UserStory: As a Prefer-A / dogfood maintainer, I want repair/setup/self-complete to deposit and keep a thin .mjs host outer with quiet disable and project-PM missing-pin messaging, so that merge gates stop rewriting .grok/hooks toward .sh or direct hook-bin and AC9.1 Decision 7 is satisfied on tip.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1) Shared thin outer template + content-hash deft-hook-<sha8>.mjs naming; F1 order + project-PM missing-pin string (no INSTALLATION_RECOVERY_GUIDANCE / AC9.7 on those paths). 2) Core agent-hooks + runtime setup-wiring/ensureHostHooks/nestedToolCommand converge; delete Grok→GROK_PRETOOLUSE_WRAPPER_COMMAND. 3) Legacy rewrite: .sh AND direct registered hook-bin → .mjs. 4) Git helper + Taskfile: disable before requiring bin.js. 5) Inspect/drift + hygiene managed paths + coverage-applicability/classifier: only .mjs success. 6) Dogfood host deposits + helper templates. 7) Tests per #5994 plan. 8) CHANGELOG this issue only. 9) pre-pr + PR stop-at:pr-open.
